analysis: Exhaustive reachability of a finite abstraction using production selection/advance functions and a separate finite AST oracle at the validation boundary. Not execution of Docker probes.
transition_space: Every successor program, including an unchanged program. Enumerate until no reachable projected state is new. Selection observes only current availability plus immutable claim/provenance and the source transition; metadata lineage is not claimed verified.

invariants.all_validate: available equals finite truth in every reachable state
invariants.intact: available equals finite truth in every reachable state
invariants.known_missing: available equals finite truth in every reachable state
invariants.hidden_missing: No false withholding; find at least one false availability state and a reachable cycle of false availability whose edges change source but select no validation.

negative_controls: Hide f->g in the intact variant: the required no-mismatch invariant must fail.
In hidden_missing, suppress previously_unavailable by presenting available=True only to selection: the required no-false-withholding invariant must fail.
outputs: all 12 source programs, values and blob identities
all reachable projected states and transitions per variant
reachable nonempty source-changing false-availability cycle and a prefix from initial state
limits: Finite authored grammar and two-valued unrelated file; not arbitrary Python.
Validation result is supplied from the finite oracle, not actual probe execution in this study.
Reachability proves properties of the stated abstraction; projection adequacy is argued from current selection/advance code.
No population frequencies, cost measurements, real admission, independent human labels, or metadata-lineage proof.
